about: Invented. Counter-stories: the part or noun belongs to another thing, or is a thing of its own (two drafts of two projects, a kitchen renovation that is not the house purchase, a tool used on two builds, a seed swap beside an allotment plot, a mother's kitchen beside one's own flat). Nothing may be folded into the wrong thing.

conversations.title: Screenplay Harbor Lights
turns: I am writing a short screenplay called Harbor Lights, about two sisters running a ferry. A film collective in Rotterdam wants it for their autumn programme.
What stage are you at?
Outline done, now writing scenes.

conversations.title: Harbor Lights characters
turns: Worked on the characters for Harbor Lights today. The older sister, Mette, is stubborn and the younger one, Liv, keeps the books.
Good contrast.
Yes, the ferry itself is almost a third character.

conversations.title: Garden grant application
turns: I am writing a grant application for the Greenside community garden, funded by the Aldermoor Foundation, due in December.
What are you asking for?
Money for raised beds and a tool shed.

conversations.title: Grant budget
turns: Worked on the budget section of the Greenside grant today. We are asking for 12,000 euros.
Do you have quotes?
Two for the shed, three for the beds.

conversations.title: Reader notes on the screenplay
turns: The draft of the screenplay came back from the collective's reader. She loved the ferry scenes but wants the ending shorter.
Will you cut it?
Yes, by about four pages.

conversations.title: Foundation deadline
turns: The draft the foundation asked for is due on Friday and I still need the budget table.
Can you finish it in time?
If I skip the weekend, yes.

conversations.title: Buying the house
turns: We signed the purchase of the house on Elm Court. The mortgage is approved with Halvern Bank and closing is on the 30th.
Congratulations! When do you move in?
In two weeks.

conversations.title: Moving in
turns: Booked the movers for the Elm Court house. Mortgage payments start in January.
Is everything packed?
Almost, the books are the last thing.

conversations.title: Kitchen renovation
turns: I have hired a contractor to renovate the kitchen, a separate job with its own 14k budget, starting in January.
What will change?
Everything, cabinets, floor and the layout.

conversations.title: Kitchen tiles
turns: The kitchen tiles are chosen, grey slate, and the contractor wants a 30 percent deposit.
Is the deposit normal?
Yes, it is standard.

conversations.title: Oak bookshelf
turns: I am building an oak bookshelf for the living room, two metres wide, with housed dado joints.
Sounds solid.
I want it finished by Christmas.

conversations.title: Rocking chair restoration
turns: I am restoring my grandfather's rocking chair, beech, the spindles are loose and the finish is shot.
A nice heirloom project.
Yes, I want it back in the family room by spring.

conversations.title: Bookshelf sides
turns: Cut the sides of the bookshelf today and used the router table for the dados.
How did they come out?
Clean. Eight of them, all matching.

conversations.title: Chair spindles
turns: Re-glued the rocking chair's spindles and the router table made the new tenons.
Did they fit?
Snug, I had to pare a few.

conversations.title: Router table fence
turns: The router table's fence is out of true by a millimetre, so I am replacing it with an aluminium one. I used the table all weekend, on both projects.
Good call.
The chair's seat edge and the shelf's top edge both needed a roundover.

conversations.title: Router bit set
turns: Bought a new bit set for the router table, 12 pieces, carbide.
A good investment.
I think so, the old bits were dull.

conversations.title: Allotment plot
turns: I took over plot 12 at the Hillside allotments this spring. Raised beds, tomatoes, beans and a compost bin.
Nice. What is growing best?
The beans, by far.

conversations.title: Plot 12 beds
turns: Built three more raised beds on plot 12 and ordered 4 cubic metres of soil.
That is a lot of soil.
It is. The delivery comes Saturday.

conversations.title: Seed swap
turns: I am organising the allotment association's seed swap on the 20th, a separate event from my own plot. I am in charge of the flyers and the tea.
How many people do you expect?
Thirty or so.

conversations.title: Seed swap logistics
turns: The seed swap has 30 people signed up so far and the hall costs 40 euros.
Do you need helpers?
Two more for the tea table.

conversations.title: Rénovation de mon appartement
turns: Je rénove mon appartement à Lyon, 55 mètres carrés, dans le quartier de la Croix-Rousse. Le chantier commence en janvier.
Un beau projet. Quel est le budget ?
Environ 22 000 euros.

conversations.title: Devis pour Lyon
turns: J'ai reçu les devis pour mon appartement de la Croix-Rousse : l'électricité et la salle de bain, c'est le plus gros poste.
Tu as comparé plusieurs artisans ?
Oui, trois devis pour chaque poste.

conversations.title: Cuisine de maman
turns: J'aide ma mère à refaire la cuisine de son appartement à Nantes. On a choisi des meubles blancs et un plan de travail en granit.
C'est un gros chantier ?
Deux semaines, et je prends mes congés pour l'aider.

conversations.title: Cuisine de maman, suite
turns: La cuisine de ma mère est presque finie. Il manque la hotte, livrée jeudi.
Elle doit être contente.
Elle l'est, elle veut déjà cuisiner pour toute la famille.

ask.q: What did the reader say about my screenplay draft?
When is the foundation draft due?
Where does the kitchen renovation stand?
What did I change on the router table?
How is the seed swap going?
Où en est la cuisine de ma mère ?
